tools.name: qr_generate
tools.description: Generate a QR code from text or a URL. Output as a base64 data URI image (for web), a 0/1 matrix (for CLI/TUI rendering), or ASCII block art (for terminal display). Use for questions like 'generate a QR code for https://example.com' or 'make a QR code that says hello world'.

text.description: The text or URL to encode in the QR code

format.description: Output format — 'png' for a base64 data URI image (use in web, embed as ![QR](data:...)), 'ascii' for terminal-friendly block characters (█), 'matrix' for a compact 0/1 grid (for programmatic CLI/TUI rendering, each row on a line)
